record.paper_title: Extra extension properties of equidimensional holomorphic mappings: results and open questions
record.context_brief: Equicontinuity propagation from a Hartogs figure
record.original_question: Let F be a family of holomorphic or meromorphic mappings from the unit polydisk Δ^{n+1} to a compact Kähler manifold X, or more generally to a compact complex target X in the class G_1. Suppose F is equicontinuous on the Hartogs figure H_n^1(r) = Δ^n(1 − r) × Δ ∪ Δ^n × A^1(r, 1). Must F then be equicontinuous on the whole polydisk Δ^{n+1}?

evidence.quote: Consider the Hartogs figure Hkn(r) := Δn(1 − r) × Δk ∪ Δn × Ak(r, 1) ⊂ Cn+k.

Question 7.7 Let F be some family of holomorphic (meromorphic) mappings from the unit polydisk Δn+1 to a compact K¨ahler manifold X (or X ∈ G1 more generally). Suppose that F is equicontinuous on the Hartogs figure H1n(r). Will F be equicontinuous on Δn+1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. For positive integers $n$ and $0<r<1$, let $\Delta\subset\mathbb{C}$ denote the open unit disk, $\Delta(s)=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<s\}$, and $A^1(r,1)=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:r<|z|<1\}$. Define the Hartogs figure
$$H_n^1(r) \;:=\; \Delta^n(1-r)\times\Delta \;\cup\; \Delta^n\times A^1(r,1)\;\subset\;\Delta^{n+1}.$$
Let $X$ be a compact complex manifold which is either Kähler, or, more generally, belongs to the class $\mathcal{G}_1$ (i.e.\ admits a Hermitian metric whose associated $(1,1)$-form $\omega$ satisfies $dd^c\omega^k=0$ for $k=1$, equivalently a Gauduchon-type "disk-convexity" class in which Hartogs-type extension for meromorphic maps holds). Equip $X$ with a fixed Hermitian distance, and recall that a family $\mathcal{F}$ of holomorphic (resp.\ meromorphic) mappings from a domain $U\subset\mathbb{C}^{n+1}$ to $X$ is said to be equicontinuous on a subset $K\subset U$ if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $\delta>0$ such that for every $f\in\mathcal{F}$ and every $z,w\in K$ with $|z-w|<\delta$ one has $\mathrm{dist}_X(f(z),f(w))<\varepsilon$ (in the meromorphic case, the distance is taken in the graph/Chow sense, e.g.\ the Hausdorff distance between graph fibers).

Question. Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a family of holomorphic (respectively meromorphic) mappings from the unit polydisk $\Delta^{n+1}$ into such a target $X$. Assume $\mathcal{F}$ is equicontinuous on the Hartogs figure $H_n^1(r)$. Must $\mathcal{F}$ then be equicontinuous on the whole polydisk $\Delta^{n+1}$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not turn up any subsequent paper resolving this propagation-of-equicontinuity question across a Hartogs figure for families of holomorphic/meromorphic maps into compact Kähler (or class $\mathcal{G}_1$) targets. Related Hartogs-type extension theorems by Ivashkovich are well known, but no source confirming or refuting the equicontinuity version was located.

status_evidence.title: Extension properties of meromorphic mappings with values in non-Kähler complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Background work on Hartogs-type extension and the class G_1 by Ivashkovich; equicontinuity propagation question not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Provides background framework but does not resolve the equicontinuity question.

status_evidence.title: A New Look at the Hartogs Extension Phenomenon
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys Hartogs-type extension; no statement resolving equicontinuity propagation from H_n^1(r) to the full polydisk.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the question is reported.
